name: Weis Supermarkets | Mt. Pocono, PA
hero_alt: Kobalt milling crew resurfacing the Weis Supermarkets parking lot
paragraphs: This Weis Supermarkets location needed its parking lot fully milled and repaved, and our crew handled the job from cold-milling the deteriorated surface through laying and compacting new asphalt.

Working around store operations, our team kept the site accessible to customers throughout the project, resurfacing the lot in phases to minimize disruption while delivering a smooth, durable finished surface.
